biggest_catch: Referrer earns a flat $50 only when the referred friend joins Interra Credit Union and opens a new checking account with a debit card; no cap is stated, but the payout takes up to 60 days after account opening.
catches: Friend must be new to Interra (no previous relationship within the last 6 months) and open a new checking account with a debit card
Friend must meet membership eligibility and account-opening criteria including minimum opening deposit
Referrer must be an Interra member and be mentioned at the time of the friend's account opening
Terms may change or terminate without prior notice

steps: Be an Interra Credit Union member
Print the Refer-a-Friend coupon from interracu.com/friend and pass it to friends/family
Friend mentions you at the time of account opening
Friend joins Interra and opens a new checking account with a debit card
$50 is deposited into your account within 60 days of their account opening
timing: Printing and handing off the coupon takes ~10 minutes active; the $50 reward is deposited within 60 days after the friend's account opening (not instant).
